title: Roadmap sprint binding and OKRs for Private Network onboarding
creator: Vivian Chen
description:
Goal: Define a tightly scoped quarterly roadmap that binds sprint-level deliverables to measurable OKRs for Private/VPC/on-prem tenant onboarding. This ticket collates the end-to-end plan for engineering, infra, security, and customer success to reduce time-to-first-request for regulated customers while preserving SLAs and upgrade safety.

Scope highlights:
- Core onramp automation (tenant bootstrap, network configuration validation, cert provisioning)
- Upgrade & rollback safety gates for air-gapped and VPC customers
- Console experiences: guided activation flow, tenant readiness dashboard, per-tenant rollout controls
- Ops playbooks for first-15-customer onboardings (runbooks, escalation matrix, SSO/KMS integrations)

Outcomes (quarter):
- Decrease median onboarding time from contract-signed to live from 10 weeks to 5 weeks for Tier-1 regulated customers.
- 99% of onboarding checklists pass automated readiness validation before manual ops steps.
- Zero severity-1 customer incidents attributable to rollout automation within first 30 days after activation.

Why now: a pipeline of 8 enterprise prospects requires deterministic activation windows; current onboarding variability blocks Dedicated/Private revenue commitments. This plan converts that pipeline into predictable commitments with guardrails for risk and capacity planning.
acceptance_criteria: Sprint plans and tasks mapped to two-week cadence with clear owners for infra, runtime, console, and docs
OKRs documented and instrumented in dashboards (time-to-live, readiness-pass-rate, post-activation S1s)
Automation e2e test with synthetic tenant validates provisioning paths for VPC and on-prem images
Runbook published in Confluence with tested escalation steps and contact rota for first 15 activations
Pilot onboardings: at least 3 customers fully activated in staging-like environments and retrospective run
